mentions.name: SSTV Encoder/Decoder Mobile App
mentions.description: This mobile app encodes and decodes SSTV (Slow Scan Television) images, enabling pictures to be sent over sound waves, primarily for use by amateur radio operators.
mentions.audience: Amateur radio operators (the ISS also occasionally broadcasts SSTV images)
mentions.source_excerpt: My first mobile app! It encodes and decodes SSTV images, allowing you to send pictures over sound waves. Mostly used by amateur radio operators... even though the ISS sometimes also broadcasts SSTV images!
